crossRefs.note: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.
Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.
When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.
For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.
The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.
Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.
It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.
A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.
For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with…
Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and extol and honor the King of heaven; for all his works are truth, and his ways…
He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.
For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”
I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be…
But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject…

translations.web: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
translations.bsb: For whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
translations.kjv: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.
translations.asv: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be humbled; and whosoever shall humble himself shall be exalted.
